name: CROSSING_YELLOW
notes: TMR Queensland TC-series design sheet with a lettered size table (drawing not to scale); every dimension from the table, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing ('CN' / 'CM' / 'DM' read as the plain series). The table's c is the yellow edge and d the edge + black border. TC9526 supplementary plate CROSSING. Size A generated (a 600 x b 250, c 8 / d 24, e 75, f 100CN, r 40; B 750 x 312, C 900 x 375 also tabled): chain e 75 / f 100C / e 75 = 250. The sheet draws the plate shallower than tabled (3:1); the table governs. Black on yellow.
